briefTitle: A Study of Sofe-M in Participants With Selected Advanced Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have one of the following solid tumor cancers: Dose Escalation: Ovarian (epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, and fallopian tube) cancer, endometrial cancer, cervical cancer, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), triple negative breast cancer (TNBC), pancreatic cancer, or colorectal cancer (CRC) ... Dose Expansion: Low grade serous ovarian cancer, cervical cancer, NSCLC, TNBC, and high grade endometrioid cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Solid tumor cohorts vary by study part and do not state a clean stage_in check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Individual with active uncontrolled systemic bacterial, viral, fungal, or parasitic infection
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled infection is a clinical judgment, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Individual with evidence of corneal keratopathy or history of corneal transplant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Corneal keratopathy or transplant is not a supported typed check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any serious unresolved toxicities from prior therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unresolved prior toxicity is an investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Significant cardiovascular disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Significant cardiovascular disease is a subjective judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prolongation of QT interval corrected for heart rate using Fridericia's formula (QTcF) ≥ 470 milliseconds (ms)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: QTcF cutoff is not among the allowed typed lab kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of pneumonitis/interstitial lung disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: History of pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease is not a supported typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Minimum Age: 18 Years
